lessons.description: Talk about meals, say what you want to eat and drink, and order in a restaurant
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 想 / 要 / 一点儿

grammar.title: 想 vs 要 — would like / want
grammar.note: 想 + verb is a softer 'would like to'. 要 is firmer: 'want, will have' — the normal word when ordering. Negative of both for wishes: 不想 ('don't feel like').

grammar.title: Measure word 杯 — a cup / glass of
grammar.note: Drinks are counted with 杯: number + 杯 + drink. The cup itself is 杯子: 这个杯子很好看.

grammar.title: 吧 for suggestions, 一点儿 'a little'
grammar.pattern: 我们吃面条儿吧！· 我想吃一点儿肉。
grammar.note: 吧 at the end turns a sentence into a suggestion: 'let's…'. 一点儿 after a verb means 'a little (of)': 喝一点儿水.

sentences.en: Have you eaten?
I'm hungry. I'd like some rice.

sentences.zh: 你要喝什么？— 我要一杯茶。
sentences.en: What would you like to drink? — A cup of tea.

sentences.zh: 早饭我吃了两个包子和一个鸡蛋。
sentences.en: For breakfast I had two buns and an egg.
The food at this restaurant is very good.
I don't eat meat; I eat fruit.
I'm thirsty. Please give me a glass of water.

sentences.zh: 我们中午一起吃面条儿吧。
sentences.en: Let's have noodles together at noon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我要一个米饭和一个肉菜。
dialogue.en: I'll have rice and a meat dish.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喝什么？我们有茶和牛奶。
dialogue.en: And to drink? We have tea and milk.

lines.zh: 早上我吃面包，喝一杯牛奶。
lines.en: In the morning I eat bread and drink a glass of milk.

lines.zh: 午饭我在学校吃米饭和菜。
lines.en: For lunch I eat rice and vegetables at school.

lines.zh: 晚饭妈妈做面条儿，很好吃。
lines.en: For dinner Mom makes noodles. They're delicious.

lines.zh: 晚上我饿了，就吃一点儿水果。
lines.en: If I'm hungry in the evening, I eat a little fruit.

questions.question: 早饭他喝什么？
questions.questionEn: What does he drink at breakfast?

questions.question: 他在学校吃午饭。
questions.questionEn: He eats lunch at school.

lines.zh: A：我饿了！我们去饭店吃饭吧。
lines.en: A: I'm hungry! Let's go eat at a restaurant.

lines.zh: B：好。你想吃什么？
lines.en: B: OK. What do you feel like?

lines.zh: A：我想吃包子。你呢？
lines.en: A: I'd like steamed buns. You?

lines.zh: B：我不饿，我渴了。我喝一杯茶。
lines.en: B: I'm not hungry, I'm thirsty. I'll have a cup of tea.

questions.question: B 很饿。
questions.questionEn: B is very hungry.

questions.question: A 想吃什么？
questions.questionEn: What does A want to eat?

lessons.description: Talk about classes, school types and studying Chinese
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 在 + place / 第 / 会

grammar.title: 在 + place + verb
grammar.note: To say where something happens, put 在 + place before the verb: 他在学校上课. Not 他上课在学校.

grammar.title: 会 — can (learned skill)
grammar.pattern: 我会写汉字。他不会说外语。
grammar.note: 会 + verb means you have learned how to do something: speak a language, write characters, drive. Negative: 不会.

grammar.title: 第 + number — ordinal
grammar.pattern: 第一课 · 第十页 · 第二个学生
grammar.note: Put 第 before a number to make 'first, second…': 第一课 = Lesson One. Page numbers use 页: 第十页 = page ten.

sentences.zh: 我是大学生，我在大学学习汉语。
sentences.en: I'm a university student. I study Chinese at university.

sentences.zh: 我们八点上课，十二点下课。
sentences.en: Classes start at eight and end at twelve.

sentences.zh: 请打开课本，读第五课的课文。
sentences.en: Please open your textbooks and read the text of Lesson Five.
Can you write this character?
Teacher Wang teaches us Chinese.

sentences.zh: 我的书包里有三本书和两个本子。
sentences.en: There are three books and two notebooks in my schoolbag.

sentences.zh: 我们班有十个男生，十五个女生。
sentences.en: Our class has ten boys and fifteen girls.
Today's dictation was hard.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which school do you go to?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我在北京的一个中学上学。
dialogue.en: I go to a middle school in Beijing.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 学。我学汉语，也学别的外语。
dialogue.en: Yes. I study Chinese and another foreign language too.

lines.zh: 我们的汉语课上午九点上课。
lines.en: Our Chinese class starts at nine in the morning.

lines.zh: 李老师先教我们读课文。
lines.en: First Teacher Li teaches us to read the text.

lines.zh: 我们再在本子上写汉字。
lines.en: Then we write characters in our notebooks.

lines.zh: 最后有一个听写。我们十一点下课。
lines.en: At the end there's a dictation. Class ends at eleven.

questions.question: 汉语课几点上课？
questions.questionEn: When does the Chinese class start?

questions.question: 他们在课本上写汉字。
questions.questionEn: They write characters in the textbook.

lines.zh: A：放学了！你回家吗？
lines.en: A: School's out! Are you going home?

lines.zh: B：回家。我的书包呢？
lines.en: B: Yes. Where's my schoolbag?

lines.zh: A：你的书包在这儿。
lines.en: A: Your schoolbag is here.

lines.zh: B：谢谢！明天我们几点上学？
lines.en: B: Thanks! What time is school tomorrow?

lines.zh: A：七点半。明天见！
lines.en: A: Seven thirty. See you tomorrow!

questions.question: 明天他们七点半上学。
questions.questionEn: Tomorrow school starts at 7:30.

questions.question: B 找什么？
questions.questionEn: What is B looking for?

lessons.description: Say where things and places are with direction and position words
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 在 + 方位 / 有

grammar.title: Thing + 在 + place
grammar.pattern: 书在桌子上。洗手间在哪儿？
grammar.note: 在 here is the verb 'to be at'. The known thing comes first: 我的手机在桌子上. Ask with 在哪儿 / 在哪里.

grammar.title: Place + 有 + thing
grammar.note: To say what is somewhere, start with the place and use 有: 'on the table there is a book'. Compare: 那本书在桌子上 (that specific book is on the table).

grammar.title: Position words: noun + 上 / 里 / 边
grammar.pattern: 桌子上 · 书包里 · 学校旁边 · 我左边
grammar.note: Short 上, 下, 里 attach to a noun: 桌子上. The longer forms (上边, 里边, 前边…) can stand alone too: 他在前边. 中间 is 'between / in the middle'.

sentences.en: Excuse me, where's the restroom?

sentences.zh: 洗手间在那边，在书店旁边。
sentences.en: Over there, next to the bookshop.
Is my book on the table?
There are two books in the schoolbag.
There's a restaurant to the east of the school.

sentences.zh: 他在我前边，她在我后边。
sentences.en: He is in front of me; she is behind me.

sentences.zh: 我坐在爸爸和妈妈中间。
sentences.en: I sit between Dad and Mom.

sentences.zh: 外边很冷，我们去里边吧。
sentences.en: It's cold outside. Let's go inside.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Have a look in your schoolbag.

lines.zh: 我的学校在北京的北边。
lines.en: My school is in the north of Beijing.

lines.zh: 学校前边有一个商店，后边有一个饭店。
lines.en: There's a shop in front of the school and a restaurant behind it.

lines.zh: 学校里边有很多树。
lines.en: There are lots of trees inside the school.

lines.zh: 我们班在二楼，左边是老师的房间。
lines.en: Our class is on the second floor; on the left is the teachers' room.

questions.question: 学校后边有什么？
questions.questionEn: What is behind the school?

questions.question: 学校在北京的南边。
questions.questionEn: The school is in the south of Beijing.

lines.zh: A：请问，这里有洗手间吗？
lines.en: A: Excuse me, is there a restroom here?

lines.zh: B：有，在那边。
lines.en: B: Yes, over there.

lines.zh: A：在那个门的右边吗？
lines.en: A: To the right of that door?

lines.zh: B：不是右边，是左边。
lines.en: B: Not the right — the left.

lines.zh: A：好的，谢谢！
lines.en: A: OK, thanks!

questions.question: 洗手间在门的右边。
questions.questionEn: The restroom is to the right of the door.

questions.question: 洗手间在哪儿？
questions.questionEn: Where is the restroom?

lessons.description: Talk about transport, travelling to places and how far they are
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 怎么 / 坐 / 从…到…

grammar.title: 怎么 + verb — how?
grammar.pattern: 去机场怎么走？· 你怎么去学校？
grammar.note: 怎么 before a verb asks 'how': 怎么去 = how to get to. 怎么走 asks for directions.

grammar.title: 坐 / 开 + vehicle + 去 + place
grammar.pattern: 我坐火车去北京。他开车去上班。
grammar.note: Means of transport come before the destination. 坐 = ride as a passenger (bus, train, plane); 开 = drive. On foot: 走路去.

grammar.title: 从 A 到 B — from A to B
grammar.note: 从 marks the starting point, 到 the end. Add 远 / 不远 to say how far it is.

sentences.en: How do you get to school?
I walk; school isn't far.

sentences.zh: 从我家到北京，坐飞机要两个小时。
sentences.en: From my home to Beijing takes two hours by plane.
Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

sentences.zh: 车站在前边路口的右边。
sentences.en: The station is on the right at the next intersection.
Let's take a taxi to the airport.
I bought the train tickets.
Watch for cars when you cross the road.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How are you getting to the airport tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'm thinking of taking the bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 从你家到机场很远，打车吧。
dialogue.en: It's a long way from your place. Take a taxi.

lines.zh: 明天我和爸爸去北京。
lines.en: Tomorrow Dad and I are going to Beijing.

lines.zh: 我们不坐飞机，我们坐火车去。
lines.en: We're not flying; we're going by train.

lines.zh: 从我家到北京要五个小时。
lines.en: It takes five hours from home to Beijing.

lines.zh: 在车上，我看书，也看外边的山和树。
lines.en: On the train I read, and I look at the mountains and trees outside.

lines.zh: 下午两点，火车到了北京车站。
lines.en: At two in the afternoon the train arrived at Beijing station.

lines.zh: 爸爸的朋友开车来车站等我们。
lines.en: Dad's friend drove to the station to wait for us.

lines.zh: 从车站到他家不远，我们打车去。
lines.en: His home isn't far from the station, so we took a taxi.

questions.question: 他们怎么去北京？
questions.questionEn: How are they getting to Beijing?

questions.question: 从他家到北京要五个小时。
questions.questionEn: It takes five hours from his home to Beijing.

questions.question: 他们几点到北京？
questions.questionEn: What time did they arrive in Beijing?

questions.question: 爸爸在北京有朋友。
questions.questionEn: Dad has a friend in Beijing.

lines.zh: A：请问，去车站怎么走？
lines.en: A: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

lines.zh: B：你看地图，车站在这儿。
lines.en: B: Look at the map — the station is here.

lines.zh: A：远吗？
lines.en: A: Is it far?

lines.zh: B：不远。走到第二个路口就到了。
lines.en: B: Not far. Walk to the second intersection and you're there.

questions.question: 车站很远。
questions.questionEn: The station is far away.

questions.question: 走到第几个路口？
questions.questionEn: Which intersection do you walk to?

lessons.description: Ask prices, count money and buy things in shops
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 多少钱 / 块 / 太…了

grammar.title: Asking the price: 多少钱
grammar.pattern: 这个多少钱？— 二十五块。
grammar.note: 多少钱 = how much money. In speech prices use 块 (yuan) and 毛 (ten fen): 三块五毛 = ¥3.50. 元 is the written form you see on price tags.

grammar.title: 太 + adjective + 了
grammar.note: 太…了 means 'too…' or 'so…!'. Keep the 了 at the end in speech: 太贵了, not just 太贵.

grammar.title: 这些 / 那些 / 哪些 — plural this, that, which
grammar.pattern: 这些衣服很好看。你要哪些？
grammar.note: Add 些 to 这 / 那 / 哪 for plural nouns. 一些 / 有些 mean 'some': 我想买一些水果.

sentences.en: How much is this bag?
120 yuan — that's too expensive!
I'd like to buy some fruit.
This fruit is 3.50 yuan.
Do you want anything else?
There's no money left in my wallet.

sentences.zh: 这个商场很大，东西也很多。
sentences.en: This mall is big, and it has lots of things.

sentences.zh: 那个书店有些书很好看。
sentences.en: Some books at that bookshop are really good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello, how much is this bag?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Too expensive! Do you have anything else?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 那个包不太贵，一百五十块。
dialogue.en: That one isn't too expensive — 150 yuan.

lines.zh: 星期六我和妈妈去商场买东西。
lines.en: On Saturday Mom and I went shopping at the mall.

lines.zh: 妈妈想给我买新衣服。
lines.en: Mom wanted to buy me new clothes.

lines.zh: 那些衣服太贵了，都五百多块。
lines.en: Those clothes were too expensive — all over 500 yuan.

lines.zh: 我们没买衣服，买了一些书和水果。
lines.en: We didn't buy clothes; we bought some books and fruit.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“别的商店有一些衣服不太贵。”
lines.en: Mom said, 'Other shops have some clothes that aren't too expensive.'

lines.zh: 下午我们去了学校旁边的一个小商店。
lines.en: In the afternoon we went to a small shop next to the school.

lines.zh: 那儿有一个好看的书包，五十块。
lines.en: There was a nice schoolbag there for fifty yuan.

lines.zh: 妈妈买了这个书包，我很高兴。
lines.en: Mom bought the schoolbag, and I was very happy.

questions.question: 她们买了新衣服。
questions.questionEn: They bought new clothes.

questions.question: 那些衣服多少钱？
questions.questionEn: How much were those clothes?

questions.question: 妈妈在小商店买了什么？
questions.questionEn: What did Mom buy at the small shop?

questions.question: 商场的衣服不贵。
questions.questionEn: The clothes at the mall weren't expensive.

lines.zh: A：你好，这本书多少钱？
lines.en: A: Hello, how much is this book?

lines.zh: B：三十八块五。
lines.en: B: 38.50 yuan.

lines.zh: A：我买两本。
lines.en: A: I'll take two.

lines.zh: B：两本七十七块。
lines.en: B: Two books is 77 yuan.

lines.zh: A：给你一百块。
lines.en: A: Here's a hundred.

questions.question: A 买了几本书？
questions.questionEn: How many books did A buy?

questions.question: 一本书三十八块五。
questions.questionEn: One book costs 38.50 yuan.
